description: context-6 LTO fx2-cmix wrapper using native no-dictionary mode to remove the counted WRT dictionary
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Uses the same cmix.bin.gz as fx2_struct_top_mixer_v1: SEED=923, UPDATE_LIMIT=3000, FX2_STRUCT_TOP_MIXER, FX2_STRUCT_TOP_MIXER_WEIGHT=16, FX2_STRUCT_TOP_MIXER_CONTEXT=6, all objects built with -Os and link-time optimization. The wrapper calls cmix as -c input output and -d input output, so no dictionary file is shipped or counted.

reset_media_slot_pruned.description: Ledger-driven source gate resetting side_slot_=2 after file/image link target boundaries to avoid page-wide media-slot leakage.
reset_media_slot_pruned.verdict: archive-positive but exact-S negative with the available compiler path; keep as a source-level signal, not a promoted package

text_wide_expert_gate_pruned.description: Ledger-driven retargeting of the existing expert selector from deep templates to all text bytes, with reset_media_slot enabled.
text_wide_expert_gate_pruned.verdict: pruned; the oracle gap is large, but this adaptive selector adds prediction noise instead of converting the gap into archive savings

verdict: Promote as the current small-tier exact-S fx2 package. Removing the dictionary grows the archive but removes a much larger counted file; the verified 10MB direct score is 1,872,226, which beats the prior local fx2 10MB score by 53,651 bytes. This is still far from the 10MB 10% target of 1,000,000, so it is a ledger improvement rather than a 10% route.
